summary: Debug request of server character creation carrying a complete character definition: the same memory as SE's character_creation::FullRespecDefinition (Components/CharacterCreation.h: Name, BaseCharacterDefinition, Appearance, Abilities, Array<LevelUpData>, Array<LevelUpKnownSpell>), redeclared here. Written by esv::character_creation::ChangeAppearanceSubsystem::Update/Abort and RespecSubsystem::Update (macOS), read by bg3.exe+0x2DBB770 (~ esv::party_preset::System::SystemLoad) and bg3.exe+0x37A3E40. Registered as a normal component although named OneFrame. Windows differs from SE in one place: the LevelUpData element is 0xE0 bytes (Spells array at +0xD0), not SE's 0xC0. Never seen alive. Registry total 448 (server row).

fields.name: _Pad2C
fields.evidence: padding to 8-byte alignment of the Guids (stride not checked on Windows; the array is trivially destructible).

fields.name: OriginatorPrototype
fields.evidence: SE SpellMetaId (Base/ExposedTypes.h); element destructor bg3.exe+0x67D5E0 DecRefs a FixedString per 0x30-byte element.

fields.name: Upgrades
fields.evidence: SE LevelUpUpgrades, kept as bytes: on Windows it is 0x70 bytes - bg3.exe+0xAF2390 destroys it with bg3.exe+0x5F18C0 at element +0x60, which frees arrays at its +0x20..+0x60 (SE's layout of LevelUpUpgrades is shorter; not redeclared).

fields.name: Spells
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0xAF2390 destroys an Array at element +0xD0 with bg3.exe+0x67D5E0 (stride 0x30, SpellMetaId); SE has it at +0xB0 (outdated for this build).

fields.name: SpellId
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0xAF25F0 DecRefs the FixedString at element +0x10, stride 0x18.

fields.name: Name
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DC16A0 (AllocRaw 0x1C0) builds an empty STDString at +0 (size 0 at +0x10, capacity 0xF at +0x14); destructor bg3.exe+0xA557B0 frees it when capacity > 0xF. SE FullRespecDefinition.Name.

fields.name: Origin
fields.evidence: Creator copies the null Guid constant DAT_14625aad0 to +0x18; SE BaseCharacterDefinition.Origin.

fields.name: BodyType
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes the uint16 at +0x48 (two bytes); SE BodyType.

fields.name: Voice
fields.evidence: null Guid at +0x80 (dword stores); SE Voice.

fields.name: field_A0
fields.evidence: Creator writes 3 to the byte +0xA0; SE BaseCharacterDefinition.field_A8 (unnamed).

fields.name: Icon
fields.evidence: SE ScratchBuffer (Appearance.Icon), kept as bytes: the Appearance block starts at +0xA8 (creator calls its constructor bg3.exe+0x5F14D0 there; destructor bg3.exe+0x6CF220 ends with the ScratchBuffer destructor bg3.exe+0x5F1670 at block +0, which frees owned buffers flagged at +0 and +0x18).

fields.name: Visuals
fields.evidence: Appearance destructor bg3.exe+0x6CF220 frees an array at block +0xA8 (= +0x150); SE Appearance.Visuals.

fields.name: Elements
fields.evidence: array freed at block +0xB8 (= +0x160); SE Appearance.Elements.

fields.name: AdditionalChoices
fields.evidence: array freed at block +0xC8 (= +0x170); SE Appearance.AdditionalChoices.

fields.name: Abilities
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +0x180..+0x19B (three qwords and a dword); SE FullRespecDefinition.Abilities.

fields.name: LevelUpData
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +0x1A0/+0x1A8/+0x1AC (Array); destructor bg3.exe+0xA557B0 runs bg3.exe+0xAF2390 on it (element stride 0xE0).

fields.name: KnownSpells
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +0x1B0/+0x1B8/+0x1BC; destructor runs bg3.exe+0xAF25F0 on it (stride 0x18, FixedString at +0x10).

open_questions: All top-level offsets are established from the bg3.exe creator and destructors; names are SE's (FullRespecDefinition), not the game's.
Kept as bytes: ScratchBuffer Icon (88) and LevelUpUpgrades (112 on Windows); the material-setting stride (48) is SE's, not checked on Windows.
SE's LevelUpData (0xC0, Spells at +0xB0) does not match this build's 0xE0 element - worth a look in Progression.h.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
